raw_output.rationale: All three approved objectives are represented exactly once, with distinct coverage of pyruvate oxidation, oxygen’s terminal role, and fermentation. The set includes short-answer recall and conceptual single-choice items, though the two multiple-choice questions use similar complete-statement structures and are relatively easy because distractors negate one fact at a time. The respiration concepts overlap appropriately without materially duplicating one another or directly revealing another answer. Scope and explanations are coherent and useful.

The set covers all three allocated objectives exactly once, with distinct focus on pyruvate oxidation, oxygen’s terminal-acceptor role, and fermentation. It includes short-answer and single-choice formats and maintains coherent cellular-respiration scope. The two multiple-choice items share a statement-comparison structure and some oxygen/terminal-acceptor content, but they assess different concepts and do not materially reveal one another’s answers. Difficulty is mostly foundational rather than application-oriented, limiting cognitive variety and overall usefulness somewhat.
